extra.message: User-controlled query parameters (req.query.red/green/blue) are passed directly to eval(). An attacker can supply arbitrary JavaScript such as ?red=process.mainModule.require('child_process').execSync('id') to achieve remote code execution.

cwe: CWE-95: Improper Neutralization of Directives in Dynamically Evaluated Code ('Eval Injection')

extra.message: The file path argument to fse.readJsonSync() comes directly from req.query.foo with no validation or path normalization. An attacker can read arbitrary files, e.g. /cwe73/read?foo=../../../../etc/passwd or an absolute path, resulting in path traversal / arbitrary file read.

cwe: CWE-73: External Control of File Name or Path
CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: req.query.text is concatenated into an HTML response sent with res.send() without output encoding. An attacker can inject script markup, e.g. /cwe79/echo?text=<script>alert(document.cookie)</script>, resulting in reflected cross-site scripting.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

extra.message: Both the header name (req.query.key) and header value (req.query.value) are taken directly from user input and passed to res.append(). An attacker can inject CRLF sequences into the value to inject arbitrary response headers or split the HTTP response (e.g. value=foo%0d%0aSet-Cookie:%20session=attacker).

cwe: CWE-113: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences in HTTP Headers ('HTTP Response Splitting')

extra.message: The endpoint reflects arbitrary user-supplied data (req.query.text) directly back to the client without any validation or filtering, exposing whatever data is placed in the parameter and enabling reflection of attacker-controlled content.

cwe: CWE-201: Information Exposure Through Sent Data

extra.message: req.query.text is concatenated into the Location target of res.redirect() without validation. An attacker can craft the text parameter to influence the redirect destination (e.g. injecting additional URL structure/scheme) and redirect users to an untrusted site.

cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')

extra.message: req.query.foo is passed directly to node-serialize's unserialize(). A value containing a function payload such as {"rce":"_$$ND_FUNC$$_function(){require('child_process').exec('id')}()"} is evaluated immediately, leading to remote code execution.

req.query.foo is passed directly as the command string to child_process.exec(), which invokes a shell. An attacker can execute arbitrary OS commands, e.g. /cwe78/childprocess?foo=cat%20/etc/passwd or foo=id;rm%20-rf%20/tmp, resulting in remote command execution.

cwe: CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
